name: Union Commonwealth University
tuition_note: 2026-27 tuition & fees from unionky.edu/admissions-aid/cost-aid/tuition-fees: tuition $29,600 + comprehensive fee $2,400 + laundry fee $110 = $32,110 (private single rate). Room only (traditional double room) $3,900/yr; board (19-meal plan) $5,300 not included in room-only figure.
